name: Tupungato
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

notes: Uco Valley wines are deep in color, intense in aroma and rich in flavor.

blurb.text: A wine area in Valle de Uco, in Mendoza, with El Peral inside. Malbec leads plantings at 47%, followed by Chardonnay (11%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (9%).
